metadata.title: Seedance Troubleshooting: Failed Generations, Quality & Common Errors
metadata.description: Fix common Seedance generation problems, including real-person errors, copyright restrictions, stuck tasks, poor quality, audio issues, and missing credits.

hero.title: Seedance Troubleshooting
hero.description: A practical Seedance troubleshooting guide for failed generations, prominent-person and face-ID errors, moderation messages, stuck processing, credit issues, and unstable output.
hero.tip: Follow the provider’s error and moderation guidance. Do not bypass safeguards, reuse unauthorized likenesses, or repeatedly resubmit an unchanged failing request.

introduce.title: Troubleshoot the failure layer first
introduce.description: Identify whether the problem is access, input validation, moderation, queueing, generation quality, output delivery, or billing—including a Face ID Seedance error or Seedance 2.0 supported languages question—before changing the prompt.

items.title: Access and account
items.description: Confirm sign-in, model availability, region, quota, plan, and whether the task can be submitted.

items.title: Input validation
items.description: Check URL reachability, file format, size, duration, aspect ratio, and whether the selected mode accepts the asset.

items.title: Moderation and rights
items.description: Read real-person, copyright, face-ID, logo, or music messages and revise the request within policy.

items.title: Task and billing
items.description: Track queue status, failure reason, cancellation, credit reservation, restoration, and result retention.

benefits.title: Common Seedance errors and safe next steps
benefits.description: A clear error message is more useful than an improvised workaround. Save the request details before contacting support.

items.title: Real-person or face-ID error
items.description: Use only authorized likenesses and supported material. Remove the reference or switch to a permitted asset; never attempt to bypass identity controls.

items.title: Copyright restriction
items.description: Replace unauthorized characters, logos, footage, or music with original or licensed references and document the source.

items.title: Stuck processing
items.description: Check the provider status, task history, queue, and cancellation path. Avoid creating many duplicate tasks while the first is unresolved.

items.title: Credits or billing mismatch
items.description: Capture task ID, timestamp, model, settings, and status, then use the provider support route to reconcile the account.

features.title: A repeatable Seedance debugging flow
features.description: Change one variable at a time and keep the smallest reproducible request that still shows the problem.

items.title: 1. Save the task record
items.description: Keep the exact prompt, model, provider, settings, input URLs, task ID, error text, and time.

items.title: 2. Reduce the request
items.description: Use one subject, one action, fewer references, and a shorter duration to isolate the failure.

items.title: 3. Validate the inputs
items.description: Open URLs, inspect file metadata, and confirm the provider accepts the format and size.

items.title: 4. Read the policy message
items.description: Separate a moderation block from a server error, timeout, quota, or invalid-parameter error.

items.title: 5. Retry intentionally
items.description: Only retry after changing the cause or after the provider confirms a transient incident.

items.title: 6. Escalate with evidence
items.description: Send the task ID and sanitized request details to the provider rather than a vague screenshot alone.

faq.title: Seedance Troubleshooting FAQ
faq.description: Clear answers for the most common Seedance searches and workflows.

items.question: How do I fix a Seedance prominent people error?
items.answer: The provider may detect a face or likeness and require authorization, a verified asset, or a different workflow. Remove the image or use an authorized reference; do not bypass the check.

items.question: Why does Artcraft Seedance 2.0 show a contain real person error?
items.answer: The request may contain protected characters, logos, footage, music, or an unauthorized transformation. Replace it with original or licensed material and follow the provider policy.

items.question: Why is Seedance stuck processing?
items.answer: Check the task status, provider incident page, queue, and cancellation controls. Save the task ID and wait for the documented retention or retry path before duplicating work.

items.question: Why did my Seedance credits not return?
items.answer: Credit handling depends on provider status and plan rules. Keep the task ID and status history, then contact the provider or site support with the exact evidence.

items.question: Why is slow motion in Seedance choppy or inconsistent?
items.answer: Reduce simultaneous actions, simplify the camera path, clarify timing, use a better reference, and test a short clip before increasing duration or resolution.

items.question: Can I bypass a Seedance moderation error?
items.answer: No. Revise the prompt or assets to comply with the policy, use authorized references, or ask the provider for clarification.

cta.title: Debug with a smaller, documented request
cta.description: Save the task evidence, isolate one failure cause, and use the provider’s support or policy path when the issue is not under your control.
